scope: JGPS-facing philosophical consolidation only; no scientific result, source reconstruction, comparator output, replay score, or source-correction authority is changed.

central_contribution.name: Discrimination Requirement
central_contribution.statement: When an invariant exposed by structural comparison is used as evidence for cognitive-capacity identity, the evidential case must discriminate source-side recurrence from commonality introduced or amplified by the representation, preservation rule, or granularity through which the comparison is made.

cpcg_position.claim: The forgetting operation is scientifically intelligible enough to constitute a live preservation alternative; the projection itself does not decide which temporal distinction is identity-relevant.
